author: PokerFace
body:
Hello everyone, some of you may remember my old map Cetacea that I made. Well guess what! I revamped it and is now coming at you better then ever. I also changed the name to Leviathan. 

Leviathan [DTM] [TM] 20v20


Builders: PokerFace

Helpers: Slvrflash, Zedther, Flufflepuff_, ScriptingLyfe

Server Host: ScriptingLyfe

YML: http://pastebin.com/5YVNT8ip

Map Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/04lzb81alz7t21e/Beluga.rar

Imgur Gallery: https://imgur.com/a/wG0T0

Features:

  • Iron Blocks
  • Diamond Blocks
  • 6 Monuments
  • Sniper Towers 
  • Lots of PvP Space
  • Rushing Opportunities
  • No Hidden Chests 
  • Space For Defense
  • Non-Laggy Chemistry Of Blocks
  • 56 TNT Per Side
  • Redstone
  • Water
Thank you for everyone's support during the making of this. Zedther especially, he helped me a lot in the 2nd version. Hopefully this map can be added to rotations. Thank you! If you wanted to see the change of what I edited, here is the old link-https://avicus.net/forums/4d71230c3

*Feel free to adjust player count if necessary as this is a big map.

replies.author: Hacktivism
replies.body: I tested this map yesterday on Nebula, and in my opinion, the current amount of TNT is way too low. I understand that you might want to have limited resources, but the problem is, a lot of players don't view TNT as a valuable resource. They wouldn't care if they died with TNT the way they would if they died with diamond armor. In other words, what I saw was two players taking all the TNT, then immediately rushing into the enemy base and dying after ten seconds. Maybe add just a bit more; I'm not expecting a full room stocked with an endless supply. But there should definitely be more than what it has right now.
